children.game_version: The Freeze-Shake Game: kids shake freely and tremble their limbs until the guitar ostinato stops.

seniors.counts: Continuous 4/4 breathing rhythm without sudden sharp neck snaps.
seniors.seated_version: Perform gentle head shaking and rhythmic arm gestures while seated in a secure chair, maintaining soft knee taps.
seniors.standing_version: Stand near a supportive rail while practicing micro-trembling of the knees and soft arm motion.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce intensity of shaking and lower musical tempo to prevent dizziness.

movement_profile.footwork: Basically no particular danced moves or steps; legs tremble continuously
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo individual spatial orientation with no partner interaction necessary
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Tense jerkiness through the upper and lower body
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Upright standing level without specified jumps
movement_profile.posture: Tense and upright with loose head and trembling legs

signature_moves.description: Continuous shaking of the head in time with the driving R&B music.
signature_moves.name: Head Shake

signature_moves.description: Rapid, tense trembling through the legs without structured footwork.
signature_moves.name: Leg Tremble

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid structured partner steps, formal foot patterns, or rigid posture.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Driving rhythm and blues ostinato beat
music_profile.sound_description: Loud, driving 1960s rhythm and blues defined by repetitive, hypnotic electric guitar ostinato figures and steady, persistent drum rhythms.

basic_steps: Initiate a continuous trembling motion through the legs.
Allow the head to shake rhythmically or erratically.
Gesticulate arbitrarily with the arms in response to the ostinato guitar beat.
teaching.formation: Individual solo dancing with no fixed formation.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly as there are no set steps or technical sequences to learn.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 rhythm and blues time with a strong electric guitar ostinato beat.
